facts.text: After config mutation, the entire config is encoded as JSON.
If indexing fails, old config is restored from rawCfgJSON.
If unsyncedDecodeAndRun fails, old config is restored from rawCfgJSON.
unsyncedDecodeAndRun unmarshals new config, runs it, swaps old context with new, then stops old apps.
run function starts each app in order; if an app fails, it stops already started apps and returns error.
On failure in run, a deferred function cleans up provisioned modules and cancels context.
provisionContext starts the admin endpoint and provisions each app.

hypotheses.text: The handoff ensures old config continues until new apps are successfully started, by swapping contexts after new config is fully running.
Failure during config loading (indexing or decode/run) restores the old config state to maintain consistency.
When an app fails to start, only the started apps are stopped, leaving the old config intact.

unknowns.text: The exact point after which the old config is irreversibly discarded is not documented; swap occurs before old apps are stopped.
If admin server replacement fails in provisionContext, the error is returned but the impact on handoff is unclear.
The restoration behavior when rawCfgJSON is empty is not fully specified; it sets rawCfg[rawConfigKey] to nil.
